verificationSources.purpose: Official request/response schema for tx_info, tx_cbor, tx_status and tip.
Confirmation convention: blocks newer than the block containing the transaction.
Independent public preprod chain-indexer observations; no facilitator response used as chain evidence.

checks.name: canonical_transaction_hash
checks.detail: Canonical hash computed from the public transaction body matches the requested hash.

checks.name: valid_transaction
checks.detail: The observed Koios responses omit valid_contract. The exact public CBOR has ledger is_valid=true, valid Ed25519 signatures and no scripts/redeemers; its canonical indexed outputs match the body. Any explicit provider invalid flag is rejected.

checks.name: preprod_provider_and_testnet_body
checks.detail: Data is queried only from the preprod endpoint; the decoded body does not select mainnet. Testnet address syntax alone cannot distinguish preview from preprod.

checks.name: distinct_payer_and_recipient
checks.detail: Every consumed regular input belongs to the pinned buyer; buyer and seller are distinct addresses.

checks.name: input_binding
checks.detail: Public CBOR inputs agree exactly with indexed input references.

checks.name: exact_seller_payment
checks.detail: Exactly 2000000 lovelace is delivered to the pinned seller in both indexed outputs and public CBOR.

checks.name: change_and_output_allowlist
checks.detail: Every remaining output returns change to the buyer; no third-party fee recipient exists in this transaction.

checks.name: indexed_outputs_match_signed_body
checks.detail: Every indexed output address and lovelace amount matches the signed transaction body.

checks.name: lovelace_only
checks.detail: This paid request transfers lovelace only; no native token output is included.

checks.name: no_other_balance_actions
checks.detail: No mint, withdrawal, deposit, donation or script execution can obscure this direct payment balance.

checks.name: network_fee_and_value_conservation
checks.detail: All consumed lovelace equals all outputs plus the exact network fee; no balance is inferred from a UI label.

checks.name: canonical_depth
checks.detail: At least one newer canonical block exists in both tip-height subtraction and the separate tx_status query.

checks.name: delegated_fee_and_total_caps
checks.detail: The independently observed economic action stays within the recorded initial service, network fee, API fee and total caps.

delivery.detail: The separately recorded paid receipt and delivered catalog hash match this observed chain transaction and input.

trust: This independently checks the hosted facilitator receipt against the public Koios preprod indexer and exact public signed CBOR. It is not a self-hosted Cardano node or a proof of irreversible finality. The catalog input/result association is application evidence; the direct address payment does not commit catalog hashes on chain.
